items.title: Carmen Leggio interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: I was featured with Bill Watrous, both of us, with the Buddy Rich band

ctx.x: Yeah I’m playing lead alto. Well this here, the Buddy Rich, this is New Orleans. That was a quintet. Woody Dennis, John Bunch, Nobby Tota on bass. This here I’m playing lead alto with the big band for about ten days. And then we did the opening of the Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts, and I was featured with Bill Watrous, both of us, with the Buddy Rich band and so on. We did the grand opening there. I just pulled out a few choice things for you see? And here’s the Benny Goodman thing with Bucky Pizzarelli…
